d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ki shuruaat aaj nahay-khay ke sath ho gaee hai. patna ke ganga ghaton par subah se hi chhath vratiyon aur shraddhaluon ki bhir umar rahi hai.
Jepi setu ghat par bari sankhya men vrati apne parivar ke sath pahunche aur ganga men snan kar char divsiy chhath puja ka sankalp liya.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
